status: Locked candidate analysis plan before KIRC performance evaluation; full image acquisition/QC pending
study_scope: Separate TCGA-KIRC retrospective OS association; no BRCA pooling, pan-cancer generalization or prospective diagnosis-time claim

endpoint.name: OS
endpoint.time_origin: Recorded CDR diagnosis origin; not shifted by BCR receipt or DICOM calendar dates

predictors.forbidden: Outcome, death, followup, last contact, receipt timing and identifiers as predictors; stages limited to declared sensitivity study
predictors.rna: Selected primary-tumour log1p TPM; variable-gene selection and all transforms fitted on training partition only
predictors.images: Actual source-verified primary WSI and CT bags; pooled mean of VALID items is shared-feature baseline, not MCAT or patch cross-attention

timing_definition.unknown_timing_policy: Retain only for explicitly retrospective association with sensitivity/limitations; no clinical deployment eligibility inferred

qc_exclusions.rule: Outcome-blind technical/identity/histology QC; record patient, source hash and reason before model evaluation
qc_exclusions.if_fewer_than_two_events_in_any_partitio: Mark affected experiment data_constrained; no arbitrary resplit

four_input_admission: Each patient has exact case-linked CLI/RNA/primary diagnostic WSI/CT identity
Raw source checksums or verified extraction provenance plus feature hashes
Finite nonempty feature bags with binary valid-item masks and declared physical preprocessing
CT patient/series/frame, physical ordering, geometry, HU, protocol/anatomy/phase QC recorded
WSI primary sample, known physical MPP, deterministic tissue/patch QC and weights recorded
No all-missing input; missing values and padded items never treated as observations

hypotheses.primary_H1: Attention with explicit masking and training modality dropout0.3 improves missing-input robustness versus identical masked attention with dropout0
hypotheses.primary_summary: Equal mean Harrell C across all15 nonempty subsets within each outer fold, then equal mean across5outer folds
hypotheses.primary_paired_contrast: dropout0.3 minus dropout0; identical patients/subsets/folds and seed ensemble
hypotheses.complete_input_guardrail: Report complete-input C, Brier and calibration separately; an aggregate cannot hide degradation
hypotheses.secondary: Clinical/unimodal/concatenation/mean comparisons, dropout0.1/0.5, stage sensitivity, uncertainty and phase/site analyses exploratory

training.selection: Inner-validation censored likelihood; no outer performance tuning
training.transforms: Training-only imputation/scaling/gene selection/dictionaries; frozen externally pretrained encoders permitted with provenance
training.all_missing_dropout: Restore one uniformly selected actually available input; do not always retain clinical input

evaluation.primary_metric: Harrell C, higher risk means earlier death
evaluation.horizon_policy: Descriptive IPCW AUC/Brier/Uno and calibration only with positive censoring support, observed cases and controls; unsupported->not_evaluated
evaluation.report_counts: Per-fold patients/deaths, cases/controls/early censoring, G(t), weight extremes and valid bootstrap replicates
evaluation.sparse_warning_convention: Fewer than10 cases or10 controls flagged descriptive instability; not a universal statistical adequacy rule
evaluation.fold_summary: Fold-specific risks/metrics; no arbitrary pooling of unscaled Cox risk across fitted folds

bootstrap.unit: patient, paired across models/subsets within outer fold
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fitted models/fixed folds; does not cover training-selection uncertainty or justify independent-fold significance claims

evaluation.censoring: Training-reference reverse KM per internal fold; independent censoring assumption and weight diagnostics disclosed
evaluation.multiplicity: One primary H1 contrast; other comparisons exploratory, no uncorrected multi-contrast superiority claim
evaluation.external: No independent paired four-input KIRC cohort currently verified

uncertainty.baseline: Censored survival likelihood and3independently trained seeds; survival-probability SD is empirical disagreement
uncertainty.validation: Held-out IPCW error association, calibration, selective risk and missing-input stress with intervals
uncertainty.edl: Not validated; no Dirichlet classification loss on continuous risk/followup, no confidence claim from evidence magnitude

published_baselines.MultiSurv: Pinned author mRNA-only model/loss feasible; shared-cohort preprocessing/training adaptations recorded separately. Official model has no CT branch and current pooled ViT/RAD vectors do not reproduce its WSI/clinical pathways
published_baselines.MCAT: Requires actual patch bags and six curated genomic functional groups with author source/config; pooled four tokens are incompatible
published_baselines.PathomicFusion: Requires original pathology/cell-graph/genomic representations and tensor gating; ordinary concatenation is not a reproduction
